artifact_findings: All 10 worksheet items and every answer-key and study-guide result were independently recomputed and agree.
The four-page worksheet is paper-heavy and some instructional text is small for K-1, but every page is readable, unclipped, and provides adequate answer space.
rationale: Correct, focused counting and cardinality practice with a strong answer key and directly useful study guide. Paper efficiency and age-fit typography are the only notable limitations.
